top_creatures.label: Large pack hunter
top_creatures.why: One hit pulls the whole group and aggro gives a distant pull; a group that moves as one reads at 375 wide.
top_creatures.keep: Group-scoped assist inside a set distance; leash-home with heal.
top_creatures.change: Our own silhouette and species; assist radius as zone data; our own pack cue.

top_creatures.label: Small pack hunter
top_creatures.why: A lighter pack member that never starts a fight but joins when a packmate is hit.
top_creatures.keep: Pack join when a packmate is struck.
top_creatures.change: Skittish, flees at low health, rather than a second fighter.

top_creatures.label: Burrowing mammal
top_creatures.why: Low profile that stays readable on the ground; the README records a mislabeled back clip column, a lesson to validate table columns against clips.

top_creatures.label: Village folk
top_creatures.why: Townsfolk that become fighters only when struck, nine of them in two groups.
top_creatures.change: Our townsfolk and their idle habits.

looks.label: Flame card
looks.technique: Crossed flat cards, additive halo, flame texture scrolled on the clock, per-copy phase from position.

looks.label: Breathing glow
looks.technique: Glow billboard scale keys pulse over one second and loop, per-copy phase.

looks.label: Clock-reborn slot particles
looks.technique: Fixed slots reborn on a clock with a hash for position and direction; the vertex shader places every particle, no simulation.

looks.label: Screen-authored smoke
looks.technique: Blended smoke drawn at eight times its file opacity so it reads on screen.

looks.label: Glows after solids
looks.technique: Additive glow cards drawn after solid scenery, depth-tested but not writing depth.

looks.label: Grass with alpha-to-coverage and sway
looks.technique: Cell-seeded plant generator, alpha-to-coverage edges, tip sway, fade over the last part of the draw range.

looks.label: Threat-coloured target ring
looks.technique: Ring colour states selected versus in a fight, readable at small width.

originals.name: Ember camp
originals.idea: Crossed additive flame cards on a clock with a per-copy phase, so a row of braziers never flickers in step.
originals.keep: Crossed additive cards, clock scroll, per-copy phase.
originals.change: Ember palette, split-tongue silhouette, our own halo colour.

originals.name: Pack pull
originals.idea: A hit on one pack hunter assists its group inside a set distance; a chaser walks home and heals past a leash.
originals.keep: Group-scoped assist and leash (parity row 4; row 23 spawn groups).
originals.change: Assist radius as zone data; our own pack cue; no villager fight.

originals.name: Corpse then return
originals.idea: Staged timers: the body lies, vanishes, then the spawn returns at home after a second timer.
originals.keep: Two timers (parity row 17 death and respawn).
originals.change: The second timer becomes a grace period tied to the zone despawn rule (row 23).

originals.name: Facing shield
originals.idea: A block that works only against blows from the front arc, on the upper body only, so the legs keep moving.
originals.keep: Front-arc gate and upper-body layer (parity row 3; row 6).
originals.change: A stamina cost instead of a flat chance.

originals.name: Tiered silhouette armour
originals.idea: Five body tiers whose outline changes, with a per-slot coverage check.
originals.keep: Shape and material chosen together (parity row 15 gear dressing).

originals.name: Density-steered scatter
originals.idea: A biome table of plant families plus a density map that keeps plants off snow and roads, cell-seeded.
originals.change: Our wetness rule and plant families.

originals.name: Authored-for-screen smoke
originals.idea: Write particle alpha for the screen, not for the data.
originals.keep: The boost idea (parity row 16 colour grade and quality).
originals.change: Our particle set and boost factor.

originals.name: Threat ring
originals.idea: A target ring whose colour states selected or in a fight, readable at 375 wide.
